expected_header_contains: Under review as a report for UoE 26/27 Sem1 INFR11269: Machine Learning Systems
appendix_policy: Optional, excluded from the main-body limit; reviewers are not obliged to read it. Essential content must remain in the main body.
notes: Main-body pages are estimated from the page containing the References heading.
If References begins on a new page, that page is excluded; if main-body content appears before References on the same page, that page counts.
If the References boundary cannot be detected reliably, page-limit checking returns WARN rather than guessing.
PDF-only checks detect visible formatting changes; exact source-file identity requires source-level verification.
